PRESERVE FLAVOR & NUTRITIONAL VALUE: The aroma barrier and leak-proof construction will ensure that your food's nutritional value is preserved for longer. Plus, they are resistant to fat, grease, oil and water.

1 OVEN BAG, UNLIMITED USES: Use your oven bags in your rice cooker or slow cooker, preserve harvested crops, store dry or liquid fertilizers, quarantine pesticides, prevent cross-contamination, odor-proofing or anything else you want! These bags are used by commercial organic farmers, food storage experts and hobby growers to keep their foods fresh, healthy and delicious.
THE TRUE LIBERTY BAGS GUARANTEE: In the improbable case that you are not 100% thrilled with your food-grade, non-toxic and made in USA all-purpose bags, we promise to offer you a full refund!
description: True Liberty Bags are ‘The ORIGINAL All-Purpose Bags and Liners’ for people who cook, freeze, camp, hike, bike, hunt, fish, move, store, garden or grow. Our industrial-strength bags are produced in the USA, BPA-free nylon: a durable, food-safe material used in countless ways.
